about: An example clips manifest for python -m fleetlab.film frame --clips FILE --out DIR (fleetlab.film.framing; site/explainer/README-footage.md). Every clip is a framed re-render of one recorded job episode, verified against its record. 'defaults' fill any field a clip leaves out (run, camera, width, height, frame_every, bodies). 'poses' adds named camera poses beside the proposed ones (hero-cabinet, hero-plate, establishing, top); a manifest's own pose wins over a proposed one of the same name. A clip's camera is the name of a pose, 'scene' or 'wrist' (the run's two observation cameras), any other camera of the LIBERO scene by its MuJoCo name (frontview, sideview, birdview, ...), or a pose written out. Positions are world metres: the table top is at z = 0.90, the robot stands at x = -0.66, the cabinet at y = -0.24 and the stove at y = +0.20. fovy is the vertical field of view in degrees; up is the world direction that is up in the picture; roll turns the picture counterclockwise in degrees. A relative 'run' is taken from this file's folder.
